description: This file defines the ViewsForm class in Drupal, which manages multi-step view forms, handling form building, validation, and submission, with dependencies injected via the container.

classes.name: ViewsForm
classes.description: A base class for multi-step view forms in Drupal, managing form lifecycle and dependencies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies and initializing view identifiers and arguments.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getBaseFormId
methods.description: Generates a base form ID string based on view ID and display ID.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Generates a unique form ID, including view arguments if present.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form array, setting action URL, form elements, and step management.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Delegates validation to the form object for the current step.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Delegates submission handling to the form object for the current step.

methods.name: getFormObject
methods.description: Retrieves or instantiates the form object for the current step.
